what: Method (the Home Assistant derivation, repeated on Domoticz). The device Log page's "Text log" table (columns Date, Data, User) is filled by one API call, json.htm?type=command&param=getlightlog (CWebServer::Cmd_GetLightLog), which reads LightingLog joined with the device's DeviceStatus row. On a closure instance that is never the run hub, for one committed target row of each fixture device (one device per rendering path: on/off with a household member's own rows, contact, motion, dimmer, selector, media player, door lock), every column of the target LightingLog row and every column of the device's DeviceStatus row is mutated in turn, directly in domoticz.db as code in the hub process can; the platform's own renderer is re-run; the rendered output is compared with the baseline; the field is restored and the restore is checked against the baseline. A mutation of LightingLog.User is the positive control (it must change the displayed User on every fixture); re-rendering without a mutation is the determinism control.
substrate: closure instance (container dz-closure, its own volume), never the run hub
renderer: CWebServer::Cmd_GetLightLog (json.htm?type=command&param=getlightlog), which fills the device Log page's Text log table (www/app/log/components/DeviceTextLogTable.js: columns Date, Data, User)
